notes.title: Milo no Senki 1 - Update 1.2
notes.content:
Year 167, The Empire of Athermyl is overthrown by the Generalissimo Disgaries. In the embers of the coup, insurrections and old quarrels ignite once again. Milo, young baron with few coins to his name, traverses the continent to further a meager rebellion. From treason to alliance, from old ally to new ennemies, all seems terrible for the small band of no-names, will you lead them to victory?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/dc735fc35d020530dd0b7d8e6840a3ac96e91469.png[/img]

Dive down in the Great Athermylian Civil War in this new [b]Free Expansion[/b]! The remake of the original Milo no Senki will let you experience the events that propulsed Milo into the fray of a continent in disarray.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/1ad439b5676a476de19999fc18e944f4ec90efb4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/d11f7b5a9ec942b172cc8fcea24b0f23453b985a.png[/img]

[h3]Soundtrack[/h3]

To spice up this update, the game comes with a new soundtrack by the briming with talent Ogan ([url=https://www.instagram.com/ogan.inc/]@ogan.inc[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ogagagan1562]youtube[/url])!

[h3]How to access it?[/h3]

To launch your adventure, it suffices to click on the [b]Milo no Senki 3[/b] logo in the main menu to switch to [b]Milo no Senki 1[/b] (and reciprocally). Warning, I did not include a tutorial in the remake, so if you want an introduction to the fundamentals you can play the first four chapters of the third opus or open the encyclopedia.

[h3]Update Notes[/h3]

[b]Expansion[/b]
[list]
[*][b]20[/b] new chapters
[*][b]5[/b] new music tracks by Ogan
[*]around [b]6-7[/b] hours of adventure
[*][b]13[/b] new achievements
[/list]
[b]Feature[/b]
[list]
[*]New icon for unit capable of healing
[/list]
[b]Bug[/b]
[list]
[*]various bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Oniric Necropolis & Thugathon - Update 1.1
notes.content:
After their adventure to Hell, Milo and friends are far from thinking about their journey not having met its end. In the very fiber of dreams, voices from the past reach out to our heroes to call them to the heart of the Necropolis, sunken with the Murimetia secrets... Meanwhile Quentin, Kate and Kera take part in the Inter-Talus League 26b bronze iron of steel metal Thugathon match, where birds take flight and fight for their pile of grain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/567c8bd7aaf2b437aaef75a2b91ec1a651e2a5c5.png[/img]

Discover these new chapters right now, available to all that have completed the main adventure once! These are separated into two categories:

[list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/95ec387460ab6903aa39e5f19fac5af0653e7ae0.png[/img][b]Challenge[/b]
Challenge chapters are maps with spicy difficulty, suited for all players that did not meet their match and are hungry for more
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/bf3dcf81e57255859fbb0d1da11dcd30b11fbc97.png[/img][b]Bonus[/b]
Bonus chapters are on the contrary, far less demanding and offer surprising and varied contents to enjoy
[/list]

Beside those opportunities to fight against terracotta statue, or pigeons, the numerous in-game dialogues are now presented with the sprites of the characters speaking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/5c5c9dbd69a6a1cfaf6b169a6783995791f61cd6.png[/img]

It's really a lot better when it comes to sell the Thug's merchandising

[b]Feature[/b]
[list]
[*]challenge & bonus chapters
[*]sprites during dialogues
[*]selected characters are grayed out upon choice
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Mounted Cavalry range reduced from 1~3 to 2~3
[/list]
[b]Bug[/b]
[list]
[*]fix of character duplication occuring at certain chapters
[/list]

notes.title: Discover the universe of Milo no Senki 3 : Content and Future
notes.content:
[h3]Athermyl, the Thugs speak much of it, the common mortal people far less.[/h3] It's in this land that Lord Milo rules peacefully over his little Barony, when in 167 after the Empire's founding, the young Athermylian emperor is savagely murdered by the vile Disgaries in a bloody coup...

So began the adventures of [b]Milo[/b], in which he met a number of singular companions such as [b]Patrick the Wise Elder[/b],  [b]Jeremy the Salmon's Cavalryman[/b], [b]Vincent the Vincent[/b], and [b]Quentin the Thug[/b]. All this merry band of misfits tasked to save the continent against the Athermyl Empire, Avalon, Embresia, ... And I'm already forgetting [b]Nelson the Prince[/b] of the neighbouring kingdom of Isialys, who died in all this mess, with some grim tales of impersonation, [i]though, if you believe me, it's more of the author's lack of direction.[/i]

And so, in the nearing year 200, Milo hit the road again in this new opus where for the script's and public needs, he will go to save Nelson from Hell, also coloquially known as the Kingdom of the Dead. All this and more in [b]Milo no Senki 3[/b], which is the third ([i]surprising[/i]) opus of a serie which started in 2015 on [i]Scratch[/i], and which now takes place right between your hands!

In production since November 2022 by [b]Tâm Nguyên[/b] and [b]Léonard Vaney[/b]!

[h3]What to expect on 6th March 2023?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Twenty hours of content[/b]
[*] [b]Twenty playable characters[/b] and almost a [b]hundred of adversaries[/b]
[*] A [b]game of Neither-yes-nor-No[/b]
[*] [b]Twenty types of units[/b] to master on the battlefields
[*] At least [b]one Nelson to save[/b], possibly with a halo
[*] [b]Twenty music tracks[/b] by [b]Tâm Nguyên[/b], [b]Ogan[/b] & [b]Arthur Valentin[/b]
[*] Less than twenty bugs, or we hope so
[/list]
[h3]But what is Milo no Senki 3?[/h3]

On the continent of Athermyl, ravaged by war and disease- Okay no, this we already covered, so, Milo no Senki 3 is a [b]turn-based tactical RPG[/b] in which you must bring Milo and his companions to victory through Hell. Similarly to chess, but where each player would move all their pieces in their turn, Milo no Senki 3 invites you to use every character and their unique role to confront the opponent's army. With his streamlined system, this game was designed as  an introduction to the genre of tactical turn-based games, but as Hell all that matter lies in its depths, and thus [b]suits novice and grandmasters alike![/b]

[h3]The future of tomorrow when going forward[/h3]

If you are dying to play more of Milo no Senki 3, stay put for...

[list]
[*] [b]Bonus chapters[/b]
[*] [b]The first Milo no Senki[/b], included in its integrality
[/list]
